description_sq:
Apartament Dupleks ne shitje tek Shallvaret Ideal per banim dhe investim!
Ne zonen premium te Shallvareve ofrohet per shitje nje apartament ne katin e 13 te nje pallati cilesor te vitit 2010, me dy ashensore dhe administrim korrekt.
Apartamenti ka siperfaqe 215 m2 bruto, 175 m2 neto dhe 32 m2 verande, me organizim funksional sipas planimetrive. Ofron nje sallon te madh dhe te ndricuar natyralisht, ambient dite e cila gezon hapsira te konsiderueshme, dhome matrimoniale me hapsire komode me dalje ne ballkon, dy tualete moderne dhe dhome teknike te vecuar. Veranda prej 32 m2 eshte nje nga pikat mne te forta te apartamentit ideale per relaks pritje osę ambient sprivat.
Prona eshte e rinovuar me materiale dhe punime te cilesise se larte, gati per banim ose investim.
Fale vendndodhjes elitare dhe siperfaqes se bollshme, apartamenti eshte i pershtatshem si per banim luksoz, ashtu edhe per investim, duke ofruar potencial shume te mire per qira premium ose zyre ekzekutive.
Apartmenti ka dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
description_en: Duplex apartment for sale in Shallvaret Ideal for living and investment! In the premium area of ​​Shallvareve, an apartment is offered for sale on the 13th floor of a quality building built in 2010, with two elevators and proper administration. The apartment has an area of ​​215 m2 gross, 175 m2 net and 32 m2 veranda, with functional organization according to the plans. It offers a large and naturally lit living room, a living room that enjoys considerable space, a comfortable matrimonial room with access to the balcony, two modern toilets and a separate technical room. The veranda of 32 m2 is one of the strong points of the apartment, ideal for relaxation, reception or a private environment. The property is renovated with high quality materials and works, ready for living or investment. Thanks to the elite location and ample area, the apartment is suitable for both luxury living and investment, offering excellent potential for premium rental or executive office. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation.
